coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: P27
names: P27 -- oval running track and field (south of UCSF Medical Center)
record.summary: A real oval running track with a central grass field, just south of the UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay campus; identified by Pier & Point from satellite imagery; since 2026-10-12 its outline is the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006, the lots under the oval (earlier it was a hand-picked piece of leftover open ground that also took in the parking lot to the north) -- not a named park record. OCII's own September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P27' among the parcels RPD 'will manage ... when built,' i.e. not yet complete as of that date. Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery shows a built oval track, but that reading is not a source for this parcel's completion, and the oval is probably Mariposa Park (P26), so no completion is stated (see open questions). Name and operator not confirmed by any source found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (8,217 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed building footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lot and can sit a little off the walls. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the open ground left between street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes, hand-picked as the oval track and field (not a surveyed parcel); 70% of that outline lies inside the lot and it covered 100% of the lot. That these three lots are the track and field is Pier & Point's inference from location and imagery: they cover the oval and lie almost entirely inside the earlier outline; no source read ties the lot numbers to P27. The earlier outline also took in the parking lot to the north, which is part of lot 8723008 and is no longer in this record. Name and operator not confirmed by any source found.
notes.digitized_from: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (mapped 2001-03-20, 2003-02-05; active), joined into one outline; the earlier outline came from: Traced as the leftover open ground between DataSF's official street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes near the UCSF Medical Center campus. Of the separate pieces this left, Pier & Point picked by hand the one showing an oval running track and central field (clearly visible on satellite imagery) as P27's real extent; not taken from a surveyed parcel.

milestones.text: Not yet built: OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P27' among the parcels RPD will manage "when built," distinct from the already-managed parcels listed alongside it

changes.text: Potrero View reported in March 2016 that Mariposa Park would open "this spring" (an expected date); no source read dates the actual opening.
P27 no longer shows a 'complete, September 2026' date. It rested only on Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery of an oval that is probably Mariposa Park (P26); no source says P27 was built.
P27 now uses its Assessor lot lines.

A September 2026 accuracy check found that nothing supports labelling the traced oval track as OCII parcel P27. It sits where Mariposa Park is (Potrero View, 2016-03-19, and SF Rec & Park's Mariposa Park page), OCII numbers Mariposa Park P26, and OCII's September 2023 deck lists P27 as not yet built. The record's name, map shape, status (complete) and 2026-09 milestone have not been changed; the identity question is noted on the record and remains open. The OCII deck's title no longer says 'CAC Item 2' (that came from its file name), and the aerial photo credit names only the Wikimedia Commons username Firstcultural.

open_questions: Whether and when this parcel was completed is not known. OCII's September 2023 Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation lists 'P27' among the parcels RPD will manage "when built"; no source says it was built. A 'complete, September 2026' milestone resting only on Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery was removed on 2026-10-12, because the oval seen there is probably Mariposa Park (P26), which Potrero View (March 19, 2016) said would open "this spring" (an expected date; no source read dates the actual opening), rather than P27.
Name and operator not confirmed by any source found; Pier & Point's mapping log for this shape notes it sits south of the hospital campus, bounded by real streets on all sides.

Whether OCII's own current numbering scheme still uses 'P27' for exactly this footprint was not independently confirmed on OCII's current public Mission Bay South open-space page, which does not list a P27 among the parcels it names (P1, P2, P3, P5, P6, P26).

Identity under review: a September 2026 re-check by Pier & Point found this oval is very likely Mariposa Park (OCII P26; SF Rec & Park's page says it "will assume the management and maintenance" of the park as of July 1, 2023, and Potrero View, March 19, 2016, said the park would open "this spring", an expected date written before the opening), not P27. Potrero View (2016-03-19, 'Mariposa Park Set to Open') places Mariposa Park 'at Mariposa and Fourth streets', SF Rec & Park's Mariposa Park page gives 'Mariposa Street and Owens', and the traced oval (centroid about -122.3915, 37.7647) sits there; UCSF's Dec 2024 map is reported to label 'MARIPOSA PARK (CITY)' just south of the hospital campus. On OCII's 2019 Land Use Map P27 is reported to be a thin sliver west of Owens St against I-280, and OCII's Sept 2023 deck lists P27 as 'when built'. The label, status ('complete'), the 2026-09 milestone and the name are left unchanged until Pier & Point decides; the 'complete' status and 2026-09 date rest only on Pier & Point's own reading of satellite imagery.
